source_note: 逐字原文以用户日志为准; 社区 Wiki 普通页面用于核对语境。日志未保留颜色码的消息不伪造 raw; 分段按语义边界保留运行时颜色。
note: 身份：末地珍珠商人。关系：向初来者提供建议，因玩家帮助朋友而回报。语言：简洁、沉稳。性格：讲人情，有阅历。风格：提醒危险但不故弄玄虚，不硬塞网络梗。

messages.context: 玩家帮独行冒险者找回弓后
messages.gloss: Wiki 写 You are [player] right?，实测用缩写及逗号，采用实测。

messages.text: My friend told me about you!
If you want a Dragon Shortbow, I'll give you one for free!
messages.raw: §fIf you want a §5Dragon Shortbow§f, I'll give you one for free!
messages.zh: 想要巨龙短弓的话，我免费送你一把!
messages.gloss: Wiki 缺少逗号，采用实测；免费赠送不能照独行冒险者的推测写成折价出售。

messages.text: A good deed demands a proper reward!
messages.raw: §fA good deed demands a proper reward!
messages.zh: 做了好事，总该有份像样的回报!

messages.text: Talk to Guber up the staircase, he is a master of traversing this troubling terrain.
messages.raw: §fTalk to Guber up the staircase, he is a master of traversing this troubling terrain.
messages.zh: 去找楼梯上面的 Guber 聊聊吧，在这种难走的地形里穿行，他可是行家。

messages.context: 提示洞穴深处的特殊资源
messages.text: The End has endless End Stone and Obsidian. You may find a special type of these resources deep in the caves.
messages.raw: §dThe End §fhas endless End Stone and Obsidian. You may find a special type of these resources deep in the caves.
messages.zh: 末地的末地石和黑曜石取之不尽。到洞穴深处去找找，说不定还能发现它们的特殊品种。

messages.context: 推荐不会惊动末影人的珍珠
messages.text: Ender Pearls attract the attention of Endermen, but Silent Pearls don't! You can get them in my shop.
messages.raw: §fEnder Pearls attract the attention of Endermen, but §5Silent Pearls §fdon't! You can get them in my shop.
messages.zh: 末影珍珠会引来末影人的注意，但无声珍珠不会! 我的店里就有卖。

messages.text: You have reached The End, though this is only the beginning.

messages.text: I am the Pearl Dealer, and you are on dangerous ground.
messages.zh: 我是珍珠商人,你脚下这片土地可不太平。

messages.context: 末影珍珠会激怒岛上的末影人
messages.text: Be careful when using Ender Pearls on this island, their energy attracts Endermen!
messages.zh: 在这座岛上使用末影珍珠时要小心,它的能量会招来末影人!

messages.text: The End also has many resources, including End Stone and Obsidian.
messages.zh: 末地也有丰富的资源,包括末地石和黑曜石。

messages.text: The deeper you go, the stranger the things you'll find!
messages.zh: 越往深处走,遇见的东西就越稀奇!
